name: Cojeabrahem
role: Petitioner for the office of Quitoal
bio: He hopes his friendship with the Upeh household and access to the fortress will help his petition. The people he brings to the fortress are disarmed.
notes: fact: Birch calls him Utimutiraja’s friend and has him bring the principals to the fortress, where Araújo reads the charges; no appointment is recorded in the episode (Birch III, pp. 147–152)
inference: The account does not establish advance knowledge of the arrest or a Persian merchants’ office (people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: His tone and optional petitions are invented; do not make him a knowing betrayer by default (people-factions.md §2)
